answer_4.quote: We conduct a user study, in which users are shown examples or DISCERN descriptions of clusters where the classifier has a higher misclassification rate than its base rate... 24 workers took part in this study conducted on Prolific and were compensated at $12/hr.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to identify if new examples match the characteristics of the given descriptions or cluster exemplars, measuring accuracy of predicting examples belonging to the erroneous cluster.
